name: Suade
description: We are an exciting, innovative Fintech/Regtech start up with a diverse workforce and global reach. We are based in the City of London using modern technologies to develop cutting edge software. Our technology is aimed at the financial services industry to help institutions understand and deliver their regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative/Sales Development Representative 2026
jobs.description:
Suade is a market-leading regtech SaaS company with cutting-edge technology that automates regulatory reporting, compliance and financial risk solutions for financial institutions. Our technology outperforms the competition on every metric, and we are supported by unprecedented need for new technology to solve complex and growing regulatory burdens. We serve Tier 1 banks across Europe, North America, and Asia.

We are seeking an ambitious Business Development Representative/Sales Development Representative to join our team. We are looking for candidates with 1-3 years’ experience in a commercial role or a sales role, who want to take their skills to the next level in a fast-growing tech company.

You will support our sales team as they create, nurture and close complex enterprise sales opportunities. You will learn from some of the best enterprise salespeople in the industry, and have the opportunity to develop into an Account Executive.

Salary: £35,000 to £40,000 plus commission, based on experience

Please note:

  • We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Candidates who need visa sponsorship now, or will need visa sponsorship in future, will not be considered.
  • This role is based in London. Suade has a flexible working policy but you will need to be available to come into the London office when required. Some travel may be required.
  • This is a fully on-site role, based in London. You will be expected to be in our London office 4 or 5 days per week. Some travel may be required.

Suade is an equal opportunity employer.We are building a world-class team and we know we need a diverse mix of talented people doing their best work.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

  • Support Suade's Account Executive team to build and close our sales pipeline
  • Contact potential clients through cold calls and emails
  • Set up meetings or calls between prospects and Suade's AEs
  • Research and prospect clients in new regions
  • Meticulously record all sales activity in our CRM, to enable data-driven decision making
  • Stay up-to-date with trends in our industry

Skills and qualifications:

  • Minimum 1 year's experience as a Business Development Representative/Sales Development Representative or similar role
  • Hands-on experience with multiple sales techniques (including cold calls)
  • Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills (over email, calls and in-person meetings).
  • Experience with CRM software (e.g. Salesforce)
  • Familiarity with MS Excel (analysing spreadsheets and data)
  • Ability to deliver engaging presentations
  • Grit, determination and a hunger to succeed in enterprise sales!

Benefits

  • 25 days' holiday + public holidays
  • Flexible holiday: choose when you take your holidays by swapping bank holidays if you would like
  • Additional tenure-based holiday: an extra day of annual leave for every year of service after 2 years
  • Flexible working hours and remote working (subject to conditions)
  • Monthly social events
  • Annual ski trip and residential offsites
  • £500 ‘work from home’ set up budget when you join
  • £500 personal training & development budget per year
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave (subject to conditions)
  • Company pension (Nest)
  • Perkbox benefits plan

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Account Executive - UK - 2026
jobs.description:
Suade is seeking an ambitious Sales Account Executive to join our team. We are looking for candidates with 2-4 years’ enterprise selling experience who want to take their skills to the next level in a fast-growing tech company.

We are a market-leading regtech company with cutting-edge technology that automates regulatory reporting, compliance and financial risk solutions for global institutions. Our technology outperforms the competition on every metric, and we are supported by unprecedented need for new technology to solve complex and growing regulatory burdens. We serve Tier 1 banks across Europe, North America, and Asia.

You will ideally have experience of consultative enterprise software with experience of the financial services industry.

This role is based in London. You will be expected to be in our London office 4 or 5 days per week. Some travel may be required.

Salary: up to 70k based on experience, plus 100% on-target commission.

Please note we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Suade is delighted to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without bias. 

Requirements

Responsibilities:

  • Build and close a sales pipeline (of new business and upsell) to meet your revenue targets.
  • Own the full sales cycle, from qualified lead to close, with a customer-centric consultative approach.
  • Build and promote strong, long-lasting customer relationships by understanding their needs.
  • Work with the delivery team to onboard new clients seamlessly and create opportunities for upselling.
  • Work closely with the business development team and marketing team to shape outreach activity that brings you high-quality leads.
  • Present deals for review, and realistic sales forecasts, to the management team.
  • Meticulously record all sales activity in our CRM, to enable data-driven decision making.
  • Support colleagues in the sales team by contributing insights into competitive landscape and customer behaviour.

Skills and qualifications:

  • 2-4 years’ enterprise selling experience.
  • Highly-motivated self-starter, comfortable with rejection, and committed to following through.
  • Results-oriented, resourceful, with a strong work ethic and willingness to go the extra mile.
  • Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills (over email, calls and in-person meetings).
  • Strong listening skills, with the ability to diagnose clients’ needs and adapt messaging immediately.
  • Ability to understand, interpret, and effectively communicate technical concepts.
  • Analytical with strong attention to detail, comfortable operating a pricing model.
  • Strong organisational and time management skills.
  • Good knowledge of CRM software, ideally Salesforce.
  • Understanding of regulatory/prudential reporting, or experience in another regulatory sector, would be a strong advantage.

Benefits

  • 25 days' holiday + public holidays
  • Flexible holiday: choose when you take your holidays by swapping bank holidays if you would like
  • Additional tenure-based holiday: an extra day of annual leave for every year of service after 2 years
  • Flexible working hours and remote working (subject to conditions)
  • Monthly social events
  • Annual ski trip and residential offsites
  • £500 ‘work from home’ set up budget when you join
  • £500 personal training & development budget per year
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave (subject to conditions)
  • Company pension (Nest)
  • Perkbox benefits plan
